about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the outpouring of the Holy Ghost cleanse our hearts, O Lord, and make their inmost depths fruitful by the sprinkling of His dew. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
